_comment: Each entry maps a capability register name to its initial state.
tag:      true | false   — whether the cap is valid
The assembler emits CSpecialRW + CSetAddr + CSetHigh (and similar)
as a prologue before the user's assembly. Each register is materialized
1. CSpecialRW <cd>, ddc, c0     # cd = almighty DDC (tag=1, full perms)
If tag is false, the assembler emits an instruction that clears the tag.
(In practice: copy from c0/CNull which is untagged.)
